messages:
maria-c: spinning up us-west2 GPU cluster, terraform apply hung on state lock and then node bootstrap failing for gpu-pool-7. Anyone else seeing this?
ashok: saw same, TF shows 'Error locking state: resource already locked' after partial apply
jules: I rolled back last night; maybe state file conflict with CI pipeline; @infra-bot which run had the lock?
infra-bot: pipeline/terraform/infra-us-west2 #342 started at 1769123000, lock created by runner-12
maria-c: runner-12 finished but didn't release lock? We have 3 failed nodeprovision attempts: docker pull timeouts, nv_peer_mem not found
ashok: logs from node-0: kubelet crash: 'failed to set device plugin directory: permission denied' — probable AMI mismatch
jules: which AMI were we using? our GPU AMI changed last week.
maria-c: tfvars show gpu_ami=ami-0c12345-updates -> that one is for nvidia 510, nodes expect 515
ashok: try switching AMI to ami-0d98765-515 and re-run bootstrap
maria-c: re-run tf apply with -target=module.gpu_pool; got error: 'route53: change not synchronized' then apply aborted
sre-oncall: network team pushed a route change earlier, looks like conflicting route53 record for node subnets; put hold on external DNS updates
jules: suggestion: release tf lock, patch AMI, re-run small canary with 2 nodes, run gpushare test, then full roll
maria-c: proceeding: releasing lock (terraform force-unlock), patch AMI, launching canary. Will report status in ~15m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ashok: ping me if it still fails; I can swap the bootstrap script to mount nv_peer_mem manually
infra-bot: terraform state unlock complete for key: /envs/prod/us-west2/state.tfstate
maria-c: canary nodes up but GPU driver mismatch warnings in /var/log/nvidia-installer.log, but kube devices registered. Running sample perf test.
maria-c: perf: `./bin/gpu-bench -c 1 --model dummy` -> 1.2k tokens/s, latency 45ms. Marking as green for now, schedule full pool rollout at 1769124000
ashok: cost note: this region has higher spot reclaim rate; consider reserved for Dedicated
jules: TY all, will add to runbook: lock-detection, AMI pinning, DNS gating step
maria-c: closing thread; followups in runbook PR #512
